To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

magnetic stimulation at Dailing and Neiguan along the pericardi meridian respectively decreased and increased the functional connection of the brain areas associated to movement and advanced cognitive functions.

the functional connections of nodes in the brain area associated with movement respectively decrease by 7.31 and 19.91% after magnetic stimulation at Daliang and Neiguan, and the functional connections between nodes of the brain areas associated respectively with emotion, memory, and language respectively increase by 24.91 and 18.83%, respectively.

the functional connectivity of the brain areas associated movement decreased and the functional connectivity of brain areas associated with cognitive functions increased after magnetic stimulation at acu-points along the Pericardium meri-dian.

the coordinated regulation mechanism of magnetic stimulation on acupoints along pericardium channel, and it is expected to provide new evidence to reveal mechanisms of brain functional network integration and network synergy of acupoint stimulation.
the coordinated regulating mechanism of acupoints in the same meridian.
the coordinated regulation of cerebral cortical functional networks in acupoints along a single meridian.

the coordinated regulation mechanism of magnetic stimulation of the pericardial meridian acupoints on the cerebral cortex is achieved by the functional integration of the brain network.
magnetic stimulation at Dailing and Neiguan points could regulate the brain function network and improve the cognitive function.
the cerebral cortical functional networks of magnetic stimulations at acupoints are related to the efficacy and therapeutic functions of specific acupoints.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the magnetic stimulation at acu-points can regulate brain functional network by modulating functional connections of the brain regions associated with advanced cognitive function, and the topological changes of functional network are related to the efficacy.
the acupoint magnetic stimulation could regulate the functional connectivity of cerebral cortex, and this regulation is associated with the therapeutic function and efficacy of acupoint.
the coordinated regulating mechanism of acupoint stimulation is related to brain functional networks and the topological structure of the networks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the brain functional network is the basis for the coordinated regulation of magnetic stimulation at the acupoints along Pericardium meridians.

the brain functional networks of magnetic stimulations at acupoints of the pericardiac meridian can be quantified by the complex network analysis method, which can provide a new method for studying the mechanism of acupoint stimulation and provide a new idea for the diagnosis and treatment of diseases.
